headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Miami Marlins 7-0, with Zack Wheeler pitching 6.0 innings and Gabriel Rincones Jr. hitting a home run and driving in 2 runs. The Washington Nationals took down the Kansas City Royals 7-3, led by Dylan Crews' home run. The Cincinnati Reds routed the New York Mets 12-0, with Chase Burns pitching 5.0 innings and Eugenio Suárez hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs. The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 3-0 shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, with Dustin May pitching 9.0 innings.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager, who has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Los Angeles Angels right-hander Grayson Rodriguez has been placed on the 15-day injured list with low back inflammation. The New York Mets have placed first baseman Jorge Polanco on the 60-day injured list with a right wrist contusion and right-hander Christian Scott on the 15-day injured list with a right hip impingement.

The Kansas City Royals made a trade on June 15, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Denis Samudio and cash.

top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a shutout victory over the San Diego Padres, with Dustin May pitching 9.0 innings and allowing 0 earned runs. Jimmy Crooks led the Padres with 1 hit and 2 RBIs in 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Seager Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers shortstop Corey Seager has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, with the move retroactive to June 12, 2026.

top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals made a move on June 15, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Denis Samudio and cash.
